items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: He comes in to see Sam's wife at all.

ctx.x: I'll tell you who used to play bass with Jack Carey for a while. Al Morgan. Yeah, Al Morgan used to play it too. And that's funny thing, Al Morgan both played, he had Isaiah Morgan and there was another Morgan, there was a trumpet player, and they used to have a band, you know, each one had a band, but Al Morgan never did play with either one of his brothers. He was working with Jack Carey, I think he worked with Chris Kelly, just gigging around with different guys.

Isaiah had a struggle with... Oh yeah? He's up in Biloxi. He comes in to see Sam's wife at all. Oh yeah. They all keep in touch. Who was in Chris Kelly? That's kind of hard for me to remember. I forgot a lot of those guys. You mentioned the drum roll player.

Yeah, what's his name? Jim Robinson. Jim Robinson was one of those guys in Chris Kelly's band. This is another one. Everybody calls him by his nickname. Who did you go to Pensacola with when you first left?
